Our Story

Twelve years of slow menswear.

Shanky is a Bengaluru atelier making men's clothing the old way: one stitch at a time, by hands that know the difference between work and craft.

"We started Shanky because we were tired. Tired of menswear that broke after a season, of shopping that felt like noise. We wanted clothing a man could put on and forget — in the best way."

— Arjun Mathur, Founder

Inside the atelier

Six pairs of hands.
One garment.

What we believe

Three quiet rules.

01

Made slow

A garment a day, not a hundred

Our atelier turns out fewer than 200 men's pieces a season. Each one passes through six pairs of hands, including a final review by our founder.

02

Worn long

Designed for the tenth year

We sketch with longevity in mind. If it will look out of place in a decade, we don't make it. The opposite of trend.

03

Mended often

Repair is part of the design

Buttons, hems, lapels, soles — built to be fixed. Tags include repair instructions. Send it back if you'd rather we did it.

The road so far

A short timeline.

2013

A small flat in Indiranagar

Started with two sewing machines, three friends, and a stubborn idea: clothing that lasts longer than a season.

2017

The first atelier

Moved into a 600-square-foot studio in Domlur. Hired our first three pattern cutters from a generations-old tailoring family.

2021

Carbon-neutral shipping

Partnered with a Western Ghats reforestation cooperative to offset every parcel we send. Still going.

2025

Lifetime mend

Every garment now ships with a lifetime repair promise. Send it back — we mend it, free.

Visit the atelier.

By appointment, weekdays. We'll pour the chai.
